recipe.startup:
set-option -s exit-empty off
set-option -g default-shell /bin/bash
set-option -g status off
set-option -gw automatic-rename off
recipe.obligation: The two messages are preloaded before mutation; displayed value1, cardinality1, FIRST=LAST=0 and exactly HH:MM: client-<observer PID> command: show-messages retained. Additional append observation cannot replace this assertion.
recipe.oracle_observer_risk: Measured tmux 3.7b logs show-messages before reading and evicts FIRST/LAST at limit1. Require the executing observer PID; normalize only its time/PID after validation.

context_semantics.input_position: Option operation before or after the input consumed by its real effect; CLI argument/parser positions still need concrete recipes.
context_semantics.terminal: Presence of a private attached TTY consumer; detached CLI transport itself may use pipes.
context_semantics.sequence: One isolated option mutation or a chained command/binding queue.
context_semantics.outcome: Expected successful effect, rejected input, input EOF, or cancellation; concrete per-route observations remain required.
context_semantics.operation: Default/read/effect or the indicated set-option flag family. Unsupported combinations remain required FAIL_MISSING until applicability is validated.

unimplemented: Per-option real consumer recipes beyond message-limit
Detailed CLI argument positions and invalid scope recipes
Validation of route/flag applicability; no automatic exclusion

default_recipe.startup:
set-option -s exit-empty off
set-option -g default-shell /bin/bash
set-option -g status off
set-option -gw automatic-rename off
default_recipe.obligation: Read the global default through unfiltered, named and value-only CLI. Exact independent oracle bytes required. This proves only default/read serialization, never rendering or message payload retention.
default_recipe.oracle_baseline: Measured tmux3.7b full raw window listing033; new independently closed oracle required before candidate.
